headline: Cocktails thrown at NCP office in Banglamotor
summary: Motorcycle-borne attackers threw three cocktails; one exploded while police neutralized two unexploded devices.
details: Three cocktails were thrown at the central office of the National Citizens' Party (NCP) in Banglamotor, Dhaka, by motorcycle-borne attackers.
The incident occurred around 12:30 AM on Thursday night.
According to a press release from the NCP, one of the cocktails exploded, while two others remained unexploded.
Police officers arrived at the scene and neutralized the two unexploded cocktails.
The NCP shared this information via a press release in a WhatsApp group for journalists at 1:55 AM.

headline_marked: 6 [[six people arrested]] for Youth Development exam leak
headline: 6 six people arrested for Youth Development exam leak
summary: The Special Response Battalion (SRB) arrested six suspects in connection with the leak of question papers for the Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officer post.
details: The Special Response Battalion (SRB) has arrested six individuals involved in the leak of question papers for the recruitment exam of Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officers.
The arrests were made during operations conducted over the last two days in Dhaka and other regions outside the capital.
Police recovered a large number of stamps, bank checks, and admit cards from the arrested suspects.
According to SRB-3's media wing, five suspects were arrested in Dhaka and one was apprehended outside the capital.
The SRB is currently conducting further operations to identify and arrest the financiers of the leak syndicate.
The leak sparked widespread protests by candidates who blocked roads in Dhaka city last Saturday.
Following the protests, the Ministry of Youth and Sports formed a five-member investigation committee led by the Ministry's Additional Secretary.
The investigation committee's report has not yet been submitted.
caption:
6 people arrested for leaking Youth Development exam papers. Police recovered stamps and bank checks from the suspects.

The Special Response Battalion (SRB) has arrested six individuals involved in the leak of question papers for the recruitment exam of Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officers.

According to SRB-3's media wing, five suspects were arrested in Dhaka and one was apprehended outside the capital.

The SRB is currently conducting further operations to identify and arrest the financiers of the leak syndicate.

The leak sparked widespread protests by candidates who blocked roads in Dhaka city last Saturday.

Following the protests, the Ministry of Youth and Sports formed a five-member investigation committee led by the Ministry's Additional Secretary.

The investigation committee's report has not yet been submitted.
